## residueColor() function

Looks up the color a residue character gets under `style`<!-- -->. Unknown characters fall back to the gap color for a scheme that recognizes the alphabet, so an unexpected residue reads as "nothing here" rather than as a real category.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function residueColor(char: string, style: ResidueColorStyle, darkMode?: boolean): string;
```
